notes.text: The linked baraita gives Rabbi Matya ben Charash’s interpretation of Moses entering the cloud. [Heilprin’s Matya ben Charash](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2584&lang=en) cites the same passage.

Charash is a conventional vocalization of חרש. Tanna is Hyman’s parenthetical classification, preserved without treating it as evidence for an expanded personal title. The abbreviated title remains R'.
